paper.title: Harnessing Pre-Resolution Signals for Future Prediction Agents
paper.central_claim: Temporal contrasts across repeated unresolved-question checkpoints yield pre-resolution signals that improve later forecasts through bounded persistent typed harness updates, beyond repeated forecasting alone.

provenance.notes: Assigned model type sonnet -> gpt-6.1-sol; no independently verifiable model/session receipt available. Blind boundary maintained; no other seat/attempt read.
